metadata.title: When Valorant hands you 2 kills but you swear it was just a sneeze
metadata.description:
Wait, was that skill or just luck wearing a costume?
Enemies probably paused Netflix mid-fight.
Click if your kills come from pure chaos and zero aim.
Valorant logic: still baffling since forever.

Tap if your best plays feel like accidents you still flex on
